subject.title: Feature: Configurable Permissions-Policy and CSP headers for Control UI

question: Should OpenClaw expose configurable Control UI CSP and Permissions-Policy headers, and if so which directives and value forms are supported?
rationale: This changes browser security boundaries for the authenticated Control UI and adds new config surface, so automation should not choose the policy contract.

options.title: Approve narrow typed policy
options.body: Add directive-limited config under `gateway.controlUi` with strict validation and tests while preserving hardened defaults.

options.title: Prefer same-origin extension route
options.body: Decline general header overrides and steer local API integrations toward plugin/gateway routes that avoid weakening browser policy.

options.title: Reject configurability for now
options.body: Keep fixed allowlists and close the feature direction unless a concrete core use case needs a new policy knob.

recommendation.title: Approve narrow typed policy
recommendation.body: Add directive-limited config under `gateway.controlUi` with strict validation and tests while preserving hardened defaults.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses Control UI CSP, gateway config, and security default policy where his recent history is strongest.
